details:
- Update to 2.50.4 to fix the following vulnerabilities:
- CVE-2025-14174: fix memory corruption via improved validation of web content
- CVE-2025-43501: fix buffer overflow with improved memory handling to
  prevent process crashes
- CVE-2025-43529: fix use-after-free in memory management to prevent
  arbitrary code execution
- CVE-2025-43531: fix race condition via improved state handling to
  prevent process crashes
- CVE-2025-43535: fix unexpected process crash through improved memory handling
- CVE-2025-43536: fix use-after-free with improved memory management for
  web content processing
- CVE-2025-43541: fix type confusion via improved state handling to
  prevent unexpected crashes
